snippet.title: MOXIE 2 // Overdrive - Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play demo now: https://platinaxo.itch.io/moxie-2-overdrive

MOXIE 2 // Overdrive is the sequel to MOXIE // Graffiti Burst, a flow-based 2D skate-n-tag game set in the Mischievous South. After President Peckington went berserk and nuked the city with a strange bomb, Veve and Gina now discover their home turf to be unrecognizable. The buildings, floors, walls and even the enemies have all warped into something very unlike the Mischievous South they know and love.

Thumbnail art by: https://x.com/HipSoul_Art
Music used: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IromawjuXq4&pp=ygUdYW5vdGhhIGxhdGUgbml0ZSBkZW56ZWwgY3Vycnk%3D
